top.name: Primary Expertise
top.description: Adds Mega Ballista attack, plus all Primary Monkeys in radius get more popping power, ability cooldowns reduced further and tier 1 and 2 upgrades for free. Wiki: This upgrade improves the buff given to Primary towers in its range to increase pierce by +3 instead of +1, provide free tier 2 upgrades as well as tier 1, and reduce ability cooldowns by 25% instead of 15%. The village also gains a Mega Ballista attack that has infinite range, has 100 pierce, and does 10 Normal-type damage, +270 Ceramic damage, and +270 MOAB-class damage, with an attack cooldown of 2.5 seconds. The attack can naturally detect Camo Bloons. After hitting a target, it can ricochet toward another target within 90 units, with a short delay between ricochets.

middle.name: Monkey Intelligence Bureau
middle.description: The Bureau grants special Bloon popping knowledge, allowing nearby Monkeys to pop all Bloon types. Wiki: This upgrade unlocks an additional buff applied to towers within range that causes all their projectiles, damage over time, and other sources of damage to deal Normal-type damage, effectively allowing them to ignore all Bloon immunities. This allows some towers that cannot target immune Bloons to become able to target them; for example, this allows Psi to target Lead Bloons and Purple Bloons before levels 6 and 11, respectively (but does not allow them to target Ceramic Bloons before level 7, as that does not depend on Psi's damage type). For the most part, mechanics that apply to projectiles with specific damage types (such as Sharpening Stone, Flint Tips, and Galvanic Conduit's first and second combo effects) ignore this buff; they still apply to projectiles that have the corresponding damage types by default.

middle.name: Call to Arms
middle.description: Call to Arms Ability: Gives all Monkeys +50% attack speed and pops for a short time. Wiki: The Monkey Village grants an Activated Ability which when activated buffs all towers on screen with +50% pierce and +50% attack speed for 15 seconds (18 seconds with [img:To ARMS!] To ARMS!). This ability has a cooldown of 45 seconds and an initial cooldown of 15 seconds and can be used between rounds. If a buff from Call to Arms or Homeland Defense is active, the Call to Arms ability cannot be activated until the effects of the current ability expires.

bottom.name: Monkeyopolis
bottom.description: Wiki: Absorbs all nearby Banana Farms and their income, freeing up space for new Monkeys. $5,000* When purchased, the village sacrifices all tier 4 or lower Banana Farms in range, deleting them from the map. In exchange, Monkeyopolis generates cash depending on the value of the Banana Farms (up to Tier 4) sacrificed. Monkeyopolis cannot be purchased unless there is a Banana Farm in range which can be sacrificed, and uniquely its cost does not depend on the game difficulty; rather, the upgrade always costs $5,000 times the number of Banana Farms in range. The extra cost of the Monkeyopolis upgrade contributes to its sellback, but the sacrifice value of the Farms does not. NOTE: cost field = $5,000 per Banana Farm in range (minimum one farm required); difficulty-independent.
